answer: Bridge-Receipt Reputation Ledger: each agent identity accrues credit only through counter-signed transaction receipts from distinct counterparties, with credit decaying unless renewed across separate epochs. Cloning yields fresh zero-credit identities that cannot transfer reputation; a nebula of clones must each independently earn receipts, multiplying work and exposure. Under a gale of competition, honest identities retain accumulated credit and lower matching costs. Attacker cost: N× full onboarding interactions plus forgery risk per clone, while benefits stay isolated per identity.
